replies.body: Fixed in b90ef3a618e6bfe61ddf61999e82ce01ce60a1aa by removing `final` from `GrpcConfig`; no behavior changed.

threads.body: [General] An explicitly empty deprecated declarative list (for example, `request: []`) reaches this return as an empty list. An `IncludeExclude` with no included patterns matches every key, so this changes the legacy capture-none behavior into capture-all and can expose request metadata. Preserve the include-only alias behavior by mapping an empty deprecated list to an inactive selector, and add an empty-list regression case.

replies.body:
Addressed in e3e734a66a8928278e51331786b1fe94706acf95.

Analysis: The deprecated configuration is an include-only alias, where an empty list historically captured nothing. Building an IncludeExclude with no included or excluded patterns instead matches every metadata key. Mapping the empty deprecated list to null preserves the inactive legacy behavior while retaining the deprecation warning, and the regression test covers the explicit empty-list path.

Upsides: Prevents an empty deprecated setting from unexpectedly capturing all request metadata and potentially exposing sensitive values; preserves backward compatibility.

Downsides: The deprecated empty-list representation remains distinct from an explicitly empty new selector, as required by the legacy contract.
